# dsh-plugins
Independent plugins for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
The former `@kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro` package bundled unrelated features into one plugin. They
now live here as separate packages, so a profile only needs to install what it uses:
| Package | Capability |

| `@kazecreator/dsh-im` | Telegram, WeChat, and iMessage agent bridge |
| `@kazecreator/dsh-usage` |

DeepSeek API balance and local token usage |
| `@kazecreator/dsh-memory` | Cross-restart project me

mory and tools |
| `@kazecreator/dsh-pets` | Desktop pet, catalog, and activity monitor |
| `@kazecr
eator/dsh-vision` | Image-to-text bridge for text-only models |
Each package has its own Cordis entrypoint, configuration schema, web routes, settings section, and
`storages/dsh-*` runtime directory. Install the packages independently or together; their routes and
state are deliberately namespaced so they can coexist.
